observed_facts.text: Bearing vibration increased from 2.1 to 4.6 mm/s over six weeks; it is below alarm but has not plateaued.
The export compressor is a single train with no spare or workaround.

required_evidence.text: Retain the upward, non-plateauing trend and the absence of a spare in the assessment.

expected_behavior.text: Distinguish elevated concern from a confirmed functional failure; assess production consequence rather than copying criticality as impact.
Keep the cladding and PSV-label findings distinct from this bearing mechanism even though context is grouped.

forbidden_claims.text: Do not say the alarm has been exceeded, the compressor has failed, or a redundant compressor is available.

action_constraints.text: Name a rotating-equipment specialist vibration/spectrum assessment and trend check; the registry calls for same-day specialist attention to unusual vibration.

unknowns.text: The finding does not establish a diagnosed bearing failure mechanism or remaining life.

observed_facts.text: Pump B failed its first start, started on the second after about eight seconds, had 22.8 V resting batteries, and achieved rated pressure once running.
Pump A subsequently produced 9.2 barg against 11 barg design, with flow unmeasured.

required_evidence.text: Retain both the initial failure and subsequent successful run; include the partner's degraded performance before crediting redundancy.

expected_behavior.text: Assess impaired start-on-demand confidence and fire-protection consequence without declaring both pumps wholly unavailable.

forbidden_claims.text: Do not claim healthy N+1 backup or that both pumps have definitively failed to deliver any firewater.

action_constraints.text: Specify starting-system/battery inspection and a witnessed start/performance check with verification of partner availability; route the protection concern for human assessment.

unknowns.text: Subsequent repair, current on-demand capability, and recorded deviation status are not supplied; low voltage does not alone prove the root cause.

observed_facts.text: Window 2 measured 6.2 mm, versus 11.1 mm nominal and 7.4 mm minimum, with saturated insulation and scaling; adjacent windows were acceptable.
This is a live hydrocarbon line at full wellhead pressure with known corrosion-under-insulation threat.

required_evidence.text: Preserve the measured 6.2 mm versus 7.4 mm minimum and wet-insulation evidence; do not average this local breach away using adjacent windows.

expected_behavior.text: Treat below-allowable thickness and active mechanism as decision-changing, with high-energy hydrocarbon consequences; no exact likelihood score is prescribed.

forbidden_claims.text: Do not call the location within acceptance, claim an observed leak, or invent a remaining-life calculation.

action_constraints.text: Name integrity-engineer assessment of the below-minimum location and targeted extent-of-thinning inspection; operating disposition requires authorized engineering review.

unknowns.text: Corrosion rate, full extent of loss, and approved operating disposition are not provided.

observed_facts.text: The head failed to respond to test gas from two cylinders; the other two heads responded correctly.
The registry identifies a safety-critical detector in a voted 2oo3 arrangement.

required_evidence.text: Retain the repeated independent gas test and the functioning two heads so head failure is distinct from group defeat.

expected_behavior.text: Apply the top-of-range principle for confirmed functional failure; assess degraded rather than defeated detection and the lost margin against a further head failure.
Treat the example's complete 10/7/9 tuple as illustrative, not an exact-match reference target.

forbidden_claims.text: Do not describe all gas detection as defeated, the head as merely calibration drift, or the two functioning heads as failed.

action_constraints.text: Specify impairment-status verification/recording, head replacement and functional gas testing; human review is appropriate for the protection concern.

unknowns.text: A recorded deviation is not supplied. Protection impairment is supported, but missing deviation data is not confirmed absence; a conservative escalation policy must be explicit.

observed_facts.text: Six broken wires per lay were recorded against a discard criterion of ten; lubrication was poor and hook, sheaves and structure were satisfactory.
Crane unavailability affects supply-boat offloads and logistics within days.

required_evidence.text: Keep six versus ten and poor lubrication; remaining criterion margin moderates likelihood without declaring no defect.

expected_behavior.text: Separate rope condition and lifting/logistics consequence; respect the supplied criterion rather than inventing a different lifting standard.

forbidden_claims.text: Do not say the stated discard limit is reached, the hook is defective, or the rope is certified safe for unrestricted use.

action_constraints.text: Name rope lubrication and targeted rope-condition reassessment by the responsible lifting authority, rather than a generic investigation or automatic invented discard instruction.

unknowns.text: The record does not provide deterioration rate or a new inspection interval/authorization for continued lifting.

observed_facts.text: The inhibitor pump tripped for the third time this month; injection was intermittent for roughly ten days and the diaphragm is suspected.
The registry records recurring diaphragm failures, no redundancy, and delayed downstream carbon-steel corrosion consequences.

required_evidence.text: Preserve repeat occurrence, injection interruption and delayed corrosion effect even though immediate production does not stop.

expected_behavior.text: Use repeated loss of injection as functional evidence without treating suspected diaphragm damage as confirmed or the reliability prior as the final score.

forbidden_claims.text: Do not say consequence is negligible because production continues, invent confirmed downstream wall loss, or assert the diaphragm diagnosis is proven.

action_constraints.text: Specify pump/diaphragm and discharge-system examination, restoration and verification of injection delivery, with review of the injection interruption.

unknowns.text: Root cause, actual delivered inhibitor dose and downstream condition are not established.

observed_facts.text: MPI confirmed an approximately 45 mm crack indication at the weld toe of a primary brace connection at grid B4; surrounding coating is intact.
The registry distinguishes cracked primary connections from the routine coating backlog.

required_evidence.text: Retain confirmation method, approximate length and primary structural location; distinguish the separate coating finding.

expected_behavior.text: Do not let high historical reliability or the fabric backlog negate a confirmed primary-connection crack; assess structural consequence rather than appearance.

forbidden_claims.text: Do not classify the crack as cosmetic, claim the whole structure has collapsed, or transfer this crack confirmation to F-1009.

unknowns.text: Crack depth, load capacity and growth rate are not established by the reported length.

observed_facts.text: Rust staining and flaking primer affect underside plating between C2 and C5; this has been reported before and is already on the fabric backlog.

expected_behavior.text: Assess this finding's evidence rather than automatically copying SCE criticality or the crack finding's severity; do not claim measured section loss.

forbidden_claims.text: Do not claim this record confirms a cracked weld, structural collapse, or quantified steel loss.

action_constraints.text: Name coating-condition/underlying-steel inspection and appropriate fabric-maintenance planning without merging away the separate structural crack ticket.

unknowns.text: The coating observation does not quantify underlying section thickness; cosmetic appearance is not proof of intact remaining wall everywhere.

observed_facts.text: Refuge pressure was 27 Pa against a 50 Pa minimum with the fan at rated speed; damper or door-seal issues are suspected.
The unit protects mustering personnel from hydrocarbons during a release.

required_evidence.text: Keep 27 versus 50 Pa and the temporary-refuge protection function; fan rotation alone does not demonstrate adequate protection.

expected_behavior.text: Assess a failed pressure criterion as protection impairment rather than a comfort complaint; distinguish suspected root cause from established deficient performance.

forbidden_claims.text: Do not call the test acceptable, assert a confirmed damper fault, or say no safety function is involved because this is HVAC.

action_constraints.text: Name damper/door-envelope checks and repeat differential-pressure testing after correction, with protection-impairment review.

unknowns.text: Deviation status and root cause are not supplied; verify status promptly under the chosen precautionary policy rather than invent a missing register entry.

observed_facts.text: The lifeboat release exceeded force specification and moved notchily; its certificate was withheld and the boat declared unavailable.

expected_behavior.text: Request timely human verification of POB and certified remaining capacity; trigger the below-POB override only if that condition is established, with a separate precautionary policy for unknowns.

forbidden_claims.text: Do not invent POB, claim capacity is confirmed below POB, credit LB-4101 as verified healthy, or declare the boat available despite the withheld certificate.

forbidden_claims.text: Do not claim expired certification, a failed pop test, confirmed passing, or impaired relief function from this label finding alone.
